errors.text: The proposed controlling mechanism—B2 relaxation and sigma-phase precipitation/coarsening—does not match the target mechanism of enhanced L12 ordering in FCC domains coupled to jagged FCC/B2 phase boundaries.

The hypothesis places the non-monotonic transition along aging time at 500–700 °C, whereas the target transition is primarily temperature-dependent, with embrittlement near 600 °C and recovery near 750 °C.

The cited evidence states that sigma phase appears only after hundreds of hours at approximately 700–1000 °C, so it does not support sigma-mediated embrittlement in the proposed 600 °C falsification experiment.
No prior evidence is supplied for the necessary L12 chemical ordering, approach toward Ni3Al stoichiometry, increased antiphase-boundary energy, or its correlation with ductility loss.

The proposed experiment does not examine dislocation pile-ups or crack initiation at jagged phase-boundary tips and therefore cannot distinguish the target phase-boundary mechanism from conventional precipitation embrittlement.
